4. World Almanac/NPCs/Henrik Van Der Voo.summary: Vallaki's coffin maker, who stole St. Andral's bones on Strahd's orders. Yevelda broke his leg throwing him at a vampire spawn.

edges.learned: S6 Best Weapon against Vampires are Old Men

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Milivoj (COS).md.summary: A Vallaki man who, once persuaded, told the party where St. Andral's stolen bones had been taken.

4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Coff.summary: Henrik van der Voort's shop in Vallaki, where the party fought vampire spawn to recover St. Andral's bones. A teleportation stone later brought them back there from Castle Ravenloft.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Baron Vargas Valla.summary: Vallaki's burgomaster, who believes his festivals can free the town from Strahd. He proposed that Ireena marry his son Victor; the party later saved him and his wife from a mob.

edges.learned: S7 Making Friends with the Necromancer

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Victor Vallakovich.summary: Baron Vargas's son, a self-taught necromancer whom the party befriended. He went missing after the mob and turned up at Castle Ravenloft.

edges.learned: S7 Making Friends with the Necromancer
S7 Making Friends with the Necromancer

4. World Almanac/Factions/House Vallakov.summary: Vallaki's ruling family: Baron Vargas, his wife, and their son Victor.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lady Fiona Wachter.summary: A manipulative figure in Vallaki who stirred up the mob that tried to execute Baron Vargas and his wife.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Izek Strazni (COS).summary: A man in Vallaki whom Yevelda flirted with on the night the mob gathered.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lady Lydia Petrovn.summary: Baron Vargas's wife, whom the party saved from the Vallaki mob alongside her husband.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Mad Mary (COS).md.summary: A distraught woman in the Village of Barovia who told the party that Gertruda had been missing for about a week.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Gertruda (COS).md.summary: A young woman of the Village of Barovia, missing for about a week, whom Victor had been visiting by teleportation.

4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Cast.summary: Strahd's castle. A teleportation circle sent the party there by surprise, and they found Victor inside.
